claims.claim: An experienced Wikimedia policy editor recalled a study finding that people who do not use AI have about a fifty-fifty chance of guessing whether a sample of text was AI-generated.
claims.quote: 50–50 chance of guessing whether a piece of sample

claims.claim: The same editor found a passage on English Wikipedia he suspected of being AI-generated and discovered from the page history that it had been written 22 years earlier.
The same draft explains AI invention as the model asserting a particular beach resort has a restaurant because many resorts do, that is, substituting the typical for the particular.
claims.source: User:LPfi/AI guidelines, English Wikivoyage draft marked experimental, revision of September 2026
claims.quote: has a restaurant because many do

claims.claim: The same draft tells editors to avoid converting an existing article into an obvious AI voice.
claims.source: User:LPfi/AI guidelines, English Wikivoyage draft marked experimental, revision of September 2026
claims.quote: avoid converting an article into an obvious AI voice

claims.claim: The same draft characterises what a large language model returns as some average or mishmash of its inputs.
claims.source: User:LPfi/AI guidelines, English Wikivoyage draft marked experimental, revision of September 2026
claims.quote: some average or mishmash of the inputs

claims.claim: The same draft bars AI from talk-page posts and instructs editors not to use the style AI chatbots tend to use.
claims.source: User:LPfi/AI guidelines, English Wikivoyage draft marked experimental, revision of September 2026
claims.quote: do not use the style AI chatbots tend to use

claims.claim: Which? found 102 mentions of food poisoning in the guest reviews of the Riu Palace Santa Maria when it checked in March 2026.
claims.source: Which?, 'Tripadvisor AI tool gives glowing reviews to dangerous hotels, Which? finds', July 2026
claims.page: section on the Riu Palace Santa Maria

claims.claim: Tripadvisor's AI summary rendered several reviewers' reports of repeated sexual harassment by staff as lapses in service noted by a few.
Which? concluded that where the summaries do reference serious allegations, the language used appears to minimise their significance.
claims.quote: the language used appears to minimise their significance

claims.claim: Tripadvisor's own account of its mechanism is that the models identify the most common themes and turn those themes into short plain-English overviews.
claims.quote: identify the most common themes and then turn those themes into short

claims.claim: Which? found that Google managed context in its AI summaries far better than Tripadvisor, its overview of the same hotel warning of potential for illness.
claims.quote: Google manages context in their AI summaries far better
